candidates.change_summary: Delete the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll performs no withdrawal.
Replace the withdrawal amount with depositsCount instead of the contract balance.
Delete the `_;` statement in onlyOwner so guarded functions like withdrawAll execute their check but skip their body entirely.
Remove the transfer statement so withdraw sends no funds to the caller.
Transfer the contract's entire balance instead of _value.
Remove the ownership check so any caller can withdraw.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners may call the guarded functions.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from sendMoney so any caller can execute it.
Delete the require(__sent_result100) check so failed calls no longer revert.
Send the contract's entire balance instead of the specified _value.
Weaken the onlyOwner check to compare against address(0) so any non-owner except address(0) is rejected and the owner is rejected.
Withdraw only balance minus 1 wei instead of the full balance.
Remove the internal withdraw call so withdrawAll sends nothing.
Withdraw a fixed 1 wei instead of the entire balance.
Invert the onlyOwner check so calls from the owner revert and non-owners proceed.
Drop the require so anyone can invoke withdrawAll.
